description: Real-Time Proximity Social Discovery — no swipe, no match request. Open chat immediately. Audio/video calls enabled once the other party has replied at least once.

stack.auth: Passwordless: Firebase Phone OTP (SMS) + Firebase Google Sign-In + custom Email OTP (6-digit via Resend) → custom JWT
stack.ai: Anthropic Claude API or OpenAI GPT-4o
stack.storage: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) — signed URLs for all media

coreMechanic.summary: No swipe. No match request. Person A taps a profile → chat opens immediately. Audio/video call buttons are VISIBLE immediately but DISABLED until Person B sends their first reply. Enforced server-side — no paid override, no bypass.
coreMechanic.callEnableRule: Calls are enabled once the non-initiating user has sent at least one message. Tracked via aHasReplied/bHasReplied on the Conversation model. Call buttons always visible in UI; only disabled before first reply. No paid override.

gridRankingAlgorithm.important: Ranking NEVER differentiates by gender identity or sexual orientation.
gridRankingAlgorithm.visibilityRule: Users inactive for more than 14 days (lastActiveAt < now - 14d) are hidden from discovery, grid, nearby, recommendations. Enforced via DB query filter, not isOnGrid flag. isOnGrid=false is only for manual panic-hide.

orientationGridLogic.notes: Grid visibility based on WHO THEY WANT TO SEE and WHO WANTS TO SEE THEM.
rules: Straight man → grids of women who want to see men
Gay man → grids of men who want to see men
Lesbian woman → grids of women who want to see women
Bisexual → all matching grids by default

safetySystem.goldenRule: Call buttons are always VISIBLE but DISABLED until the other party has sent at least one message. Tracked via aHasReplied / bHasReplied on Conversation. No paid override. No bypass.

blockingSystem.mutualVisibility: Fully mutual — if A blocks B, B also cannot see A in any listing (grid, search, nearby, likes, matches, profile views, recommendations)
blockingSystem.conversationHiding: Block immediately sets aIsHidden=bIsHidden=true on the conversation; conversation disappears from both users' inboxes. Messages preserved in DB for moderation. Visibility restores if block is removed.
blockingSystem.utility: isBlocked(userAId, userBId) checks both directions. Every user-listing query must filter blocked users.

safetySystem.panicHide: One tap sets isOnGrid=false + pauseIncomingMessages=true. Reversible. Chats preserved.

flow.phone: Firebase Phone Auth SMS → Firebase ID token (carries phone_number) → POST /api/v1/auth/firebase → NearMe JWT. Sets phoneVerified=true.
flow.google: Firebase Google Sign-In → Firebase ID token (carries email) → POST /api/v1/auth/firebase → NearMe JWT. Sets emailVerified per token.
flow.email: POST /api/v1/auth/email/send-otp → POST /api/v1/auth/email/verify-otp → NearMe JWT directly (no Firebase involved). Sets emailVerified=true.

notes: Socket.IO: connect with io(baseUrl, {auth:{token}}) — socket joins room user:<id> on connect.
Auth: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. Refresh on 401 via /auth/refresh.

Error envelope: {error:string, message:string, requestId:string, details?:any}. Every request gets a unique requestId (UUID) echoed in X-Request-ID response header. Pass X-Request-ID in requests to correlate logs.
Fuzzy location: API NEVER returns lat/lng — only distanceLabel or 'Near you' for hideExactDistance users.

CRITICAL — Call gate (Change 2): calls enabled when the OTHER party has replied. aHasReplied = User A has sent a message; bHasReplied = User B has. Call buttons always visible; returns audioCallEnabled/videoCallEnabled=false until flag is true. No paid override.

CRITICAL — Blocking (Change 1): bidirectional — if A blocks B, B cannot see A in ANY listing. isBlocked(a,b) utility covers both directions. Conversation aIsHidden=bIsHidden=true on block. Raw messages preserved for moderation.
CRITICAL — Free interaction cap (Change 6): 20 unique people lifetime. Counts first message OR first like to a new person. Subsequent interactions with same person do NOT count. Paid users: no cap.
CRITICAL — 14-day inactivity (Change 4): lastActiveAt < now-14d hides user from grid/discovery/nearby/recommendations. Enforced via DB query filter, not isOnGrid. isOnGrid=false is panic-hide only.

CRITICAL — isVerified: computed = phoneVerified OR emailVerified (face verification removed 20260618). Updated whenever either verification status changes. Returned on ALL user card/profile responses.
CRITICAL — Profile photo (Change 3.2): single optional profile picture. No minimum photo requirement for discovery eligibility.

UserCard response fields (Change 5): profilePhoto, firstName, age, distance, lastActiveAt (human-readable), isVerified, height, weight, bodyType, skinTone, aboutMe, whereAreYouFrom, relationshipStatus, lookingFor, whereWeCanMeet, preferences, fantasyTags, tribes, tags, isShortlisted, isLiked.

Albums (Change 7): /api/albums endpoints. Plan limits: free=1/10, premium=3/30, gold=5/50, platinum=unlimited/100. Photos: JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10MB, AWS Rekognition moderated. Served as signed GCS URLs (15 min expiry). Block check on /api/v1/users/:userId/albums.
Plan enforcement: check user.plan and user.planExpiresAt on every gated endpoint. Expired plan = free tier.
Agora calls: agoraToken generated server-side using AGORA_APP_CERTIFICATE (never expose to client). Token expires in 1 hour.
Women safety defaults on signup: verifiedUsersOnlyFilter=true for users who specify gender=woman.
Moderation: AWS Rekognition scans all uploaded photos/clips before publish. Required for all album photo uploads.
AI features: use claude-sonnet-4-6 for icebreakers/reply suggestions/profile optimizer. All opt-in.
Health endpoints (no auth): GET /health → {status:'ok'}, GET /health/live → {status:'ok'}, GET /health/ready → checks DB+Redis, returns {status:'ok'|'error', db, redis}.
Request logger: every response emits structured JSON {requestId, userId, method, path, statusCode, durationMs, plan} to stdout.
Spec: /Users/suryprakash/Project/backend-spec.json (use frontend-from-spec skill to consume).
Auth: Firebase Auth handles identity. Client gets Firebase ID token via Firebase SDK, exchanges at POST /api/v1/auth/firebase for NearMe JWT pair (accessToken + refreshToken).
bearer+verified gate: valid accessToken AND (emailVerified=true OR phoneVerified=true). Google Sign-In users are always verified. Email+password users must verify their email first.

Right Now (IMPLEMENTED): User model adds rightNowStatus (varchar 120, nullable), rightNowCategory (text: drinks|coffee|workout|hangout|other, nullable), rightNowExpiresAt (timestamp, nullable). Set via PATCH /api/v1/me; clear with PATCH /api/v1/me { rightNowStatus:null, rightNowCategory:null, rightNowExpiresAt:null }. Migration: 20260617_right_now_fields.
UserCard (IMPLEMENTED): now includes rightNowStatus, rightNowCategory, and rightNowActive (= rightNowExpiresAt > now()). Status/category are nulled on the card once the status expires.

GET /api/v1/discovery/right-now (IMPLEMENTED, bearer+verified): feed of nearby users (≤100km via Redis geo) with rightNowExpiresAt > now(), isOnGrid=true, lastActiveAt > now()-14d, not blocked, same orientation filter as the grid. Returns { statuses: UserCard[] (each + rightNowStatus, rightNowCategory, rightNowExpiresAt), total }.

GET /api/v1/discovery/views (IMPLEMENTED, Gold+/premiumFeature('viewed_me')): { views: [{ id, viewer: UserCard, viewedAt }] }. GET /api/v1/discovery/taps (IMPLEMENTED): { taps: [{ id, sender: UserCard, createdAt }] }. POST /api/v1/discovery/taps sends a tap. DELETE /api/v1/discovery/taps/:userId (IMPLEMENTED) removes a tap (un-fire); returns 204. Emits socket 'tap.received' { tapId, senderId, senderCard, createdAt } to the receiver on send.

GET /api/v1/profile/users/:userId (getPublicProfile) (IMPLEMENTED): now returns isLiked (viewer has an active Tap on this user) and isShortlisted (viewer has a Favorite on this user) so the profile screen renders Fire/Star state consistently with the grid. Still upserts a ProfileView unless viewer is incognito or viewing self.

GET /api/v1/me/photos/upload-url (IMPLEMENTED, alias of /api/v1/me/upload-url): { uploadUrl, gcsPath, expiresAt }. Client PUTs bytes to uploadUrl then POST /api/v1/me/photos { url, isPrimary } (url must be a fully-qualified URL).

Self (GET /api/v1/auth/me) (IMPLEMENTED): now includes primaryPhotoUrl (published primary Photo.url, or null) and callLimits. callLimits = { audioMinutesUsed, audioMinutesLimit, videoMinutesUsed, videoMinutesLimit } for FREE plan only (base 5 audio / 2 video per day + active *_call_topup add-ons; resets at UTC midnight); null for paid plans (unlimited).

Grid query additions sent by the Filters screen (handle server-side on GET /api/v1/grid): gender (csv), relationshipIntent (csv), verifiedOnly (bool, Premium+), activeLast30Min (Premium+), activeLast5Min/recentlyJoined/highReplyRate (Gold+), radius (meters; free ≤25km, Gold+ ≤100km), advancedFilters (JSON string of { education?, occupation?, language?, religion?, drinking?, smoking?, relationshipGoal? } each string[], Premium+).

Dating Rooms (Groups): brand-new module (migration 20260619_dating_rooms). Endpoints under /api/rooms (bearer+verified). Message/member endpoints require room membership (requireRoomMember -> 403 not_a_room_member). Messages run AI text moderation (adapters/moderation.classifyText) -> 451 message_flagged. Unread tracked in Redis rooms:lastread:{userId}:{roomId}. Socket channel room:{roomId}; sockets auto-join on connect for joined rooms. Username in room UI = firstName; phone/email/exact location never exposed.
